rv.q: Full of charm and holiday delight, Georgiana and Kitty: Christmas at Pemberley is a joy from start to finish.
“Georgiana and Kitty: Christmas at Pemberley” is a fitting climax to the trilogy, and will leave you with a smile on your face and a song in your heart.
Yet that’s a minor point in Connie Canady Howard’s sprightly, solidly acted and thoroughly enjoyable production, which unfolds on Jacqueline and Richard Penrod’s handsome, well-appointed set.

cn.t: Critics find this Pride and Prejudice spinoff charming and well-executed, praising its exploration of female friendship and feminist themes of equality and agency that will delight Austen fans.
